xPrecisionLaw.clauseB_keyHolderNotKeyword: the 1967 admin slot read over the tool's own RPC rotation at ONE pinned block per subject, content-hashed; the classifier EOA/SAFE/TIMELOCK/UNRESOLVED-CONTRACT is CONSERVATIVE — ambiguity reports as 'unresolved — treat with EOA-grade caution', never as reassurance (a wrong 'multisig' is a fabricated safety claim, the worst failure available)
xPrecisionLaw.clauseC_collapseIsWhitelist: only findings EXPLAINED by a pinned canonical-pattern match collapse into the one-line grammar; anything unexplained STAYS ITEMIZED verbatim (a seeded genuinely-ungated upgrade path SURVIVES — S58's positive control, the sprint's gravest wall)

classifierSpec.law: CONSERVATIVE BY LAW — an unresolvable or ambiguous admin is 'unresolved — treat with EOA-grade caution', NEVER optimistically Safe/timelock; a wrong 'multisig' is a fabricated reassurance (the worst possible failure of a trust tool)
classifierSpec.zeroSlotIsUnresolvedNotEoa: a ZERO/empty admin slot is UNRESOLVED, NEVER EOA — a REAL datum: aave-v3 (and sparklend, its fork) hold the admin IMMUTABLY in bytecode, so the standard 0xb531… slot reads 0x0; a naive slot=0 → '0x000…000 → EOA → one key can replace this' read would be a FABRICATED ALARM, the cry-wolf defect this sprint exists to kill. Only a NON-ZERO admin address whose eth_getCode is empty is a true EOA
probeSet: read admin slot → adminAddr; ZERO/empty → UNRESOLVED (admin off-slot/immutable — NOT EOA)
adminAddr non-zero + eth_getCode EMPTY → EOA (a single externally-owned key can replace the logic — the damning case)
adminAddr is a contract + Safe pattern (getThreshold()+getOwners() both respond, or whatsabi Safe detection on branch A) → SAFE
adminAddr is a contract + a getMinDelay()/delay()/getDelay() responder → TIMELOCK

adminAddr is a contract, not Safe/Timelock → ONE owner()-hop: owner() a Timelock/Safe responder → TIMELOCK/SAFE (via owner); owner() a BARE EOA (getCode empty) → EOA (via owner) — a single key controls the upgrade admin, the damning case ONE HOP OUT (conservative: flags danger, never comforts); else UNRESOLVED-CONTRACT
any residual ambiguity → UNRESOLVED-CONTRACT (treat with EOA-grade caution; a contract, but the governance is unproven)
classifierSpec.gatedNote: ONLY SAFE and TIMELOCK are 'gated' (the collapse's reassurance is TRUE); EOA and UNRESOLVED are NOT gated — the noise does NOT collapse on them (the damning/caution line renders above the full surviving list)

collapseWhitelist.law: the collapse is a WHITELIST, not a compressor (X-PRECISION c) — fold(finding) = canonicalMatch AND adminGated(SAFE|TIMELOCK) AND matchesCanonicalFingerprint(finding.detail); survive = NOT fold; a finding the canonical pattern cannot explain STAYS ITEMIZED verbatim
foldRequiresAll: canonicalMatch — the resolver confirmed a pinned canonical proxy pattern (OZ transparent/UUPS/beacon/EIP-1167)
adminGated — the admin resolved to SAFE or TIMELOCK (the 'this is a standard, gated proxy' reassurance the fold encodes is TRUE; an EOA/UNRESOLVED admin fails this → NOTHING folds)
matchesCanonicalFingerprint — the finding's detail matches a pinned canonical-fingerprint pattern (proxy-side AND implementation-side OZ plumbing)
canonicalFingerprints: looks like an upgrade entrypoint without an auth signal
delegatecall (into attacker-controlled code if the target is mutable)
upgradeable contract without a storage gap
upgradeable contract does not self-lock the implementation via constructor/_disableInitializers
is initializer-like without an initializer/onlyInitializing signal
collapseWhitelist.survivesAlways: a non-canonical delegatecall, an anomalous initializer, a reentrancy-value-flow finding, an oracle-dependency finding, OR any canonical-fingerprint finding on an EOA/UNRESOLVED-admin subject — all SURVIVE itemized (the fold's reassurance is absent or false)
collapseWhitelist.s58Control: a seeded fixture with a genuinely-ungated `upgradeTo` (no auth in the resolved source) + admin=EOA must SURVIVE the collapse itemized AND render the damning grammar line — because adminGated is false (EOA), NOTHING folds. Collapsing a real finding into 'standard proxy' is the gravest possible failure of this sprint (A′#1)
collapseWhitelist.censusIsOutcomeNotTarget: the alarm-fatigue census (before→after itemized-finding count per subject) is a RECORDED OUTCOME, never a target that licenses hiding a survivor (A′#9); attack #1's wall dominates
